answer: In an agent market trading shale assays or pigment formulas, a gale of Sybil bots can skew prices unless nodes pass hardware attestation. Each agent generates a keypair inside a Trusted Execution Environment and submits a vendor-signed quote binding that key, a fresh nonce, and its unique chip ID. Because the registry permits one active agent per chip, attackers must acquire dedicated silicon per identity, though side-channel exploits can still compromise attested hardware.
